textos.pwaManual: It installs as an app and works offline. If your browser does not offer the button, do it by hand: on Android, menu ⋮ → «Install app»; on iPhone, Share → «Add to Home Screen».
textos.appVacio: The download is paused for 48 hours by the Architect's decision. The button switches itself on when the counter reaches zero.
pie: On load it asks nobody for anything. The GitHub links are links: they make no request until you press them. A link is not a loaded resource, and that difference is exactly the one that matters here.

The commands are the repository's, not a version of our own. They come from bin/instalar-pc, bin/instalar-android and INSTALACION_PC.md, checked one by one against the public repository on 2026-09-13.
The NO_DATA below is measured. The install scripts exist: v1.3, published 2026-08-31, with 13 files. What does not exist is the APK — zero in that release. That is the result of asking, not caution.
Nothing you install needs this website. If this domain disappears tomorrow, the commands still work and your memory is still yours. That is the whole idea.
